game.title: Pokémon Pokopia
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Pokémon Pokopia is Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive with no native achievement list on any platform. The game has no combat/battle system; there are no boss-type trophies. Several researched facts were left deliberately vague to avoid Rule 1/2 violations where sources conflicted: Environment Level's maximum value (5 vs 10 in different guides), the exact Pokédex species total (300 vs ~304), and the exact General Request count (~60 vs 74) are never hardcoded in a trophy description — trophies instead point at the in-game screen that shows completion. Shiny Pokémon were excluded entirely: official Pokémon.com community consensus says they don't exist, against one unreliable fan guide claiming a 1/500 rate. Time-limited real-world events (seasonal cosmetics, Mystery Gift codes) were excluded per Rule 13's 'reasonably achievable in the future' spirit, since a future player has no guaranteed way to earn them. The base list targets the game as of the free Ver. 2.0.0 update (Aug 5, 2026), which is now standard for all owners. The `dlc` list covers Expansion Pass Part 1 'Bubbly Basin' (released Aug 5, 2026) at the user's request; Parts 2 and 3 had not released as of this list's research date (Aug 12, 2026) and are not represented.

trophies.name: New Look
trophies.description: Change your character's appearance for the first time using a mirror.
trophies.verification: The character customization screen opens from the mirror and the new appearance is applied immediately.

trophies.name: Make a New Friend
trophies.description: Befriend your first Pokémon by completing a habitat for it.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon is marked as befriended in the Pokédex screen and moves into its habitat.

trophies.name: Handmade
trophies.description: Craft an item from a learned recipe for the first time.
trophies.verification: The crafted item appears in your inventory or storage.

trophies.name: Digging Up History
trophies.description: Find your first hidden collectible — a Mysterious Slate, a fossil piece, or a Music CD — by breaking open a glowing spot.
trophies.verification: The found item is added to your inventory, and Mysterious Slates or fossil pieces additionally appear on the Mysterious Mural or the Museum's pedestal display respectively.

trophies.name: The First Request
trophies.description: Complete your first Important Request.
trophies.verification: The Requests menu shows the Important Request marked as completed.

trophies.name: Breathing Life Back
trophies.description: Raise a region's Environment Level for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Environment Level indicator at that region's Pokémon Center rises above its starting value.

trophies.name: Open For Business
trophies.description: Rebuild your first region's Pokémon Center.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon Center structure changes from its ruined state to rebuilt, and its PC becomes usable.

trophies.name: Play Time
trophies.description: Unlock your first minigame by completing the Pokémon request tied to it.
trophies.verification: The Requests menu shows the unlocking request completed, and the minigame becomes playable at that Pokémon's habitat.

trophies.name: What's This Worth?
trophies.description: Give a Lost Relic to Professor Tangrowth for appraisal.
trophies.verification: The appraisal reward (a recipe or usable item) is added to your inventory or recipe list.

trophies.name: Into the Unknown
trophies.description: Visit a Dream Island for the first time by showing Drifloon a doll.
trophies.verification: The Dream Island loads as a new, separate destination.

trophies.name: Better Together
trophies.description: Play with another player via local Link Play for the first time — no Nintendo Switch Online subscription required.
trophies.verification: The session screen shows a second connected player in your world or theirs.

trophies.name: Green Thumb
trophies.description: Grow and harvest your first vegetable.
trophies.verification: The harvested vegetable is added to your inventory and the planted plot resets to regrow.

trophies.name: A Storm Passes
trophies.description: Reach Great Rank by completing Withered Wasteland's main Important Request and meeting Kyogre.
trophies.verification: A rank-up notification confirms Great Rank, and the gates to Bleak Beach and Rocky Ridges open on the map.

trophies.name: Thunder and Flame
trophies.description: Reach Ultra Rank by completing the main Important Requests of both Bleak Beach and Rocky Ridges, meeting Raikou and Volcanion.
trophies.verification: A rank-up notification confirms Ultra Rank, and the gate to Sparkling Skylands opens on the map.

trophies.name: Full Circle
trophies.description: Rebuild the Pokémon Center in every region: Withered Wasteland, Bleak Beach, Rocky Ridges and Sparkling Skylands.
trophies.verification: All four Pokémon Centers show as rebuilt, and the Team Initiation Challenge becomes available in the Requests menu.

trophies.name: Echoes of the Past
trophies.description: Revive all 9 prehistoric fossil Pokémon.
trophies.verification: All 9 fossil-revived species show a befriended mark in the Pokédex.

trophies.name: Game Night
trophies.description: Unlock all four minigames — Jump Rope, Hide-and-Sneak, Look That Way, and Quizzes — by completing their associated Pokémon requests.
trophies.verification: The Requests menu shows all four minigame-unlocking requests completed.

trophies.name: Jack of All Trades
trophies.description: Learn at least one crafting recipe in every recipe category.
trophies.verification: The Crafting menu shows at least one unlocked recipe in every category tab.

trophies.name: Friend of the Neighborhood
trophies.description: Complete General Requests from Pokémon residents in all four story regions.
trophies.verification: The Requests menu logs at least one completed General Request for each of the four regions.

trophies.name: The Master Ball
trophies.description: Reach Master Rank by completing Sparkling Skylands' main Important Request and meeting Mewtwo.
trophies.verification: A rank-up notification confirms Master Rank after the Mewtwo encounter.

trophies.name: A World Reawakened
trophies.description: Complete the Pokédex by registering every obtainable Pokémon in the base game.
trophies.verification: The Pokédex screen shows 100% completion.

trophies.name: Voice from Beyond
trophies.description: Attach all 27 Mysterious Slates to the Mysterious Mural.
trophies.verification: The Mysterious Mural screen shows every slate slot filled, revealing its reward.

trophies.name: New Horizons
trophies.description: Unlock Palette Town.
trophies.verification: Palette Town appears as a travel destination on the region map.

trophies.name: What Lies Beneath
trophies.description: Discover the hidden hideout beneath the coastal structure in Withered Wasteland.
trophies.verification: The hideout opens as an explorable area, and its resident Pokémon can be befriended.

trophies.name: Liftoff
trophies.description: Complete the game's final Important Request and reach the ending.
trophies.verification: The full ending sequence plays out, and Palette Town becomes available to visit afterward.

trophies.name: The Shape of Home
trophies.description: Earn every other base-game trophy.
trophies.verification: All 25 other POKO trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: Beneath the Waves
trophies.description: Unlock and enter Bubbly Basin for the first time.
trophies.verification: Bubbly Basin appears as an explorable area connected to Bleak Beach, with its ruined Pokémon Center visible.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: Making a Splash
trophies.description: Use the Dive ability to explore underwater in Bubbly Basin for the first time.
trophies.verification: The character submerges below the water's surface using the Dive action.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: A Gift from the Sea
trophies.description: Find the Starmie doll in Bubbly Basin and unlock its exclusive Dream Island.
trophies.verification: A new Dream Island becomes available for travel after showing Drifloon the Starmie doll.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: A New Face
trophies.description: Register your first Bubbly Basin-exclusive Pokémon in the Basin Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon's entry appears with a caught mark on the Basin Pokédex screen.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: Charting the Depths
trophies.description: Build every habitat listed in the Habitat Dex (Basin).
trophies.verification: The Habitat Dex (Basin) screen shows every habitat entry marked as discovered and built.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: Raising the Depths
trophies.description: Raise Bubbly Basin's Environment Level enough to unlock both the Ocean Temple and Pokémon Center rebuild requests.
trophies.verification: Both the Ocean Temple and the Basin Pokémon Center rebuild requests become available in the Requests menu.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: Full Fathom
trophies.description: Complete the Basin Pokédex by registering every Bubbly Basin-exclusive Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Basin Pokédex screen shows every Bubbly Basin Pokémon registered, with no entries left unfilled.

trophies.name: Expansion Bubbly Basin: A Sea Spirit's Trust
trophies.description: Befriend Manaphy, the Mythical Pokémon of Bubbly Basin.
trophies.verification: Manaphy appears with a befriended mark in the Basin Pokédex.
